literal: Thinking of the return of him who separated, my heart climbs to the peak, holding onto the love we enjoyed when united.
translation: Thinking of the return of my departed lover, my heart climbs to the very peak of the love we once shared in union.
modern: பிரிந்து சென்ற காதலரின் வருகையை நினைத்து, நாங்கள் ஒன்றுபட்டிருந்தபோது அனுபவித்த காதலைப் பற்றிக்கொண்டு என் நெஞ்சம் அதன் உச்சிக்கு ஏறிச் செல்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet beautifully captures the heroine's intense anticipation of her lover's return. When she thinks of his homecoming, her heart does not merely wait; it actively climbs to the highest peak of the love they experienced when they were together. The word 'kōṭu' means a branch or a peak, and 'koṭu' is used here in the sense of holding onto something for support. Her heart uses the memory of their past united love as a branch to hold onto, climbing higher and higher into a state of ecstatic expectation.
